description: This file defines string manipulation functions for the Starboard platform, including string duplication, comparison (case-insensitive), formatting, and scanning, with support for both narrow and wide characters. It also includes inline wrappers for variadic functions.

methods.name: SbStringDuplicate
methods.description: Duplicates a string by allocating memory and copying the source string.

methods.name: SbStringCompareNoCase
methods.description: Compares two strings ignoring case differences.

methods.name: SbStringCompareNoCaseN
methods.description: Compares the first 'count' characters of two strings ignoring case.

methods.name: SbStringFormat
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into a buffer, similar to snprintf.

methods.name: SbStringFormatF
methods.description: Inline wrapper for SbStringFormat using variadic arguments.

methods.name: SbStringFormatUnsafeF
methods.description: Unsafe inline wrapper for SbStringFormat, using SSIZE_MAX as buffer size.

methods.name: SbStringFormatWide
methods.description: Formats a wide-character string with variable arguments.

methods.name: SbStringFormatWideF
methods.description: Inline wrapper for SbStringFormatWide using variadic arguments.

methods.name: SbStringScan
methods.description: Scans a string for a pattern and extracts values.

methods.name: SbStringScanF
methods.description: Inline wrapper for SbStringScan using variadic arguments.
